CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: The Release Operator builds, validates, packages, verifies instruction-root inclusion, and distributes local unsigned desktop builds.

UnitStatement: The Future Domain Engine Integrator defines Domain Engine Profiles, deterministic adapters, protected path rules, manifest requirements, and operation-proposal workflows; this role appears only after the harness runtime spine, permissions, tools, hooks, and result storage are stable.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: The Future Domain Reviewer is an accountable reviewer who examines domain-engine proposals, deterministic results, provenance, and professional-boundary notices before any accepted domain state changes.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Principle: filesystem is the database - project state is represented as human-readable files under the working root.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Principle: git is the event store for project truth - review, audit, rollback, and approvals bind to git-tracked content.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Principle: runtime events are an audit trail, not project truth; session logs explain what happened but gate-relevant decisions must still land in versioned project files.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Principle: human authority at every gate - agents propose; humans approve, issue, sign, seal, and decide.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Principle: evidence over plausibility - claims require provenance, and unknowns become TBD, not guesses.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Principle: no hidden memory for project truth - runtime convenience state is allowed only when explicitly non-authoritative.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Principle: instruction root and working root are separate - release-managed agent OS files must not be modified by project execution.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Principle: provider-adapter-general, contract-owned - provider SDKs may supply generic agent-loop mechanics, but Chirality owns the runtime contract exposed to the app and to project governance.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Principle: reliance boundaries are first-class - audit, permission, lifecycle, filesystem-truth, transcript-canonicality, and human-gate semantics must be defined and tested in Chirality terms, not inferred from provider/SDK defaults.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Principle: engine replaceability by construction - every adapter must sit behind explicit contracts, conformance tests, and fallback criteria so upstream changes do not silently redefine the product.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Principle: SDK isolation - shipped builds must not load ambient user/global Claude Code settings; programmatic options and Chirality instruction-root policy are the source of runtime behavior.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Principle: provider-neutral core - core runtime records, APIs, and tests use Chirality terms; Claude/SDK-specific identifiers, message names, transcript paths, permission modes, and tool names are translated at the adapter boundary.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Principle: routes stay thin - HTTP routes parse requests, handle transport, acquire/release locks, and forward events, while runtime services own behavior.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Principle: persist accepted user input early - a killed or interrupted process must leave a recoverable accepted-turn record.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Principle: separate UI events from runtime events - browser UIEvents remain stable and compact while persisted runtime events may be richer and versioned.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Principle: expose only policy-permitted capabilities to the model - tool-surface resolution happens before adapter request construction, and allowedTools alone is not enough.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Principle: hard denies override allows - provider/SDK deny rules, hook denials, path-containment failures, protected-path rules, release/professional boundaries, and governance denials override any allow decision.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Principle: safety lives in runtime code - prompts reinforce safety but do not replace path containment, permission policy, hooks, result budgets, timeouts, and packaging/network controls.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Principle: MCP is a transport, not a bypass - in-process Chirality MCP tools must pass through the same permission, hook, path, redaction, and event-logging policy as SDK built-ins.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Principle: product identity stays Chirality - SDK usage must not make the app look, behave, or describe itself as Claude Code.

UnitStatement: FR-024 (P0): unknown option keys shall be ignored with warnings and must not break turns or silently mutate behavior.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-025 (P0): persona names shall resolve to agents/AGENT_*.md; missing personas return PERSONA_NOT_FOUND.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-026 (P0): persona aliases shall map UI labels to canonical agents - HELP->HELP_HUMAN, ORCHESTRATE->ORCHESTRATOR, AGGREGATE->AGGREGATION, RECONCILING->RECONCILIATION, AGENTS->HELPS_HUMANS.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-027 (P0): production provider mode shall support the Claude Agent SDK-hosted Anthropic path - CHIRALITY_HARNESS_PROVIDER=anthropic resolves to the SDK-backed TurnEngine after R1 cutover while stub mode remains testable.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-028 (P0): the runtime shall compose real agent instruction context into SDK turns, including selected agent instruction content, global instruction context, working-root boundaries, mode, and the configured permitted tool surface.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-029 (P1): boot fingerprints shall reflect actual prompt and SDK-policy inputs including persona content hash, governance preface hash, mode, SDK tool names/versions, permission-policy version, settings-source posture, MCP server versions, and subagent policy version.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-030 (P0): Anthropic API key resolution shall follow ENV+UI - UI safeStorage key first, then ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, then CHIRALITY_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-031 (P0): key material shall remain non-project-truth convenience state and no key is written to working root, docs, logs, runtime event payloads, or git-tracked execution files.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-032 (P0): Anthropic base URL shall be allowlisted - only https://api.anthropic.com with no credentials and port empty/443 is accepted.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-033 (P0): Electron renderer outbound traffic shall be blocked except loopback and Anthropic API; webRequest.onBeforeRequest cancels non-allowlisted outbound requests and logs policy metadata without secrets.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-034 (P1): provider errors shall be classified - auth, rate limit, timeout, API error, network error, invalid base URL, and policy violation produce typed SDK_FAILURE details with key redaction.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-035 (P1): provider integration shall be wrapped by the SDK-backed turn boundary, isolating SDK request/stream mapping in TurnEngine, sdk-options-builder, and sdk-message-mapper rather than the HTTP route.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-036 (P0): UI shall allow file attachments from the selected working root, with a picker supporting navigation, multi-select, preview chips, remove, and clear.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-037 (P0): the server shall treat client attachment metadata as non-authoritative and revalidate path, extension, file type, readability, symlink status, and size.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-038 (P0): the attachment resolver shall enforce supported file types and budgets - extension, regular-file, per-file 10 MB, and total 18 MB raw-byte rules.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-039 (P0): the Anthropic provider shall map supported files to content blocks - images as base64 image blocks, PDFs as document blocks, and text/markdown/csv as text document blocks.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-040 (P1): attachment failure handling shall be resilient - partial failures prepend a warning, total failure without text rejects the turn, and the UI preserves draft/attachments on failed send.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-041 (P1): the Toolkit panel shall expose per-turn options - model, tools, max turns, mode, persona, and governance metadata as supported by runtime.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-042 (P1): Toolkit settings shall persist locally and remain non-authoritative, not overriding governance enforcement or project truth.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-043 (P1): chat drafts and attachment selections shall persist locally per root/persona/mode; malformed records are dropped and storage failures warn without breaking chat.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-044 (P1): Toolkit mode controls shall map to permission policy modes once the policy engine exists, enforcing read/write/ask/dontAsk behavior in runtime rather than as prompt hints.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-045 (P0): execution roots shall follow the docs/SPEC.md layout, containing INIT.md, package folders, and tool roots such as _Aggregation, _Change, _Coordination, _Decomposition, _Estimates, _Reconciliation, _Archive, _Scripts, and _Sources.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-046 (P0): package folders shall follow flat PKG-XX_Label or PKG-XXX_Label structure with required subfolders created or validated and no nested packages.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-047 (P0): deliverable folders shall follow DEL-XX-YY_Label or DEL-XXX-YY_Label structure, detected by scan as folders with _STATUS.md and a valid DEL prefix.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-048 (P0): deliverable metadata files shall be canonical - _STATUS.md, _CONTEXT.md, _DEPENDENCIES.md, _REFERENCES.md, _SEMANTIC.md, and MEMORY.md expectations follow SPEC.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-049 (P1): document kit files (Datasheet, Specification, Guidance, Procedure) shall be supported as first-class knowledge buckets detected for knowledge-type scope.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-050 (P0): tool path policy shall enforce working-root containment, resolving project-relative/absolute paths and rejecting paths outside the active project root.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-051 (P0): runtime tools shall protect the instruction root - writes are blocked, reads follow explicit policy, and release-managed files are never mutated.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-052 (P0): _STATUS.md shall be the canonical lifecycle state file; the status parser reads Current State, Last Updated, and history.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-053 (P0): lifecycle transitions shall be forward-only and actor-authorized per SPEC; unauthorized actors and backward transitions fail.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-054 (P0): human gate transitions shall require approval SHA evidence - transitions to CHECKING or ISSUED require a 7-64 char hex SHA-like token.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-055 (P0): Dependencies.csv v3.1 shall be parsed and validated, exposing required headers, enum values, identity rules, and warnings via contract APIs.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-056 (P0): dependency rows shall preserve provenance - active extracted rows require EvidenceFile and SourceRef or explicit location TBD.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-057 (P1): dependency writes shall preserve lifecycle behavior, serializing rows with schema version, host deliverable consistency, and warnings for legacy/invalid data.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-058 (P0): the full instruction root shall include the indexed core agent suite and governance docs - packaged resources contain agents/, docs/, AGENTS.md, README.md, docs/WHAT-IS-AN-AGENT.md, and PROFESSIONAL_ENGINEERING.md where required by integrity policy.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-059 (P0): agent instruction files shall declare type/class/surface/write-scope/blocking/output metadata auditable against governing instruction architecture and SPEC.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-060 (P0): Type 2 subagent injection shall fail closed, requiring CHIRALITY_ENABLE_SUBAGENTS=true, persona allowlist, contextSealed=true, pipelineRunApproved=true, non-empty approvalRef, and Type 2 candidate files.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-061 (P1): deterministic project tools and scripts shall remain indexed and executable when present, with tool registries and validation scripts identifying inputs/outputs and remaining locally runnable.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-062 (P1): snapshot-producing workflows shall write immutable snapshot folders and mutable _LATEST.md pointers; reruns create new timestamped folders and prior snapshots are not overwritten.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-063 (P1): CHANGE/publication workflows shall require explicit approval tokens and SHA checks; approval records include candidate SHA/action list and CHANGE rechecks HEAD before approved actions.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-064 (P0): unit and API tests shall cover runtime, workspace, lifecycle, dependency, scaffold, attachment, key storage, network policy, and packaging behavior; frontend/src/__tests__ stays comprehensive and npm run test passes when dependencies and required instruction-root assets are present.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-065 (P0): TypeScript typecheck shall pass for Next.js and Electron code; npm run typecheck exits zero.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-066 (P0): harness premerge validation shall be repeatable locally and in CI; npm run harness:validate:premerge creates frontend/artifacts/harness/section8/latest/summary.json with required SDK test IDs.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-067 (P0): the desktop distribution build shall include instruction-root integrity verification; npm run desktop:dist runs build, packages DMG, and runs instruction-root:integrity.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-068 (P1): CI shall upload a stable harness summary artifact; the harness premerge workflow validates server readiness and uploads summary JSON.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-069 (P1): Section 9 runtime validation shall be added as runtime phases land, with new validation IDs covering event log, tool runtime, permission precedence, result budget, context compaction, and subagent lifecycle.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-070 (P0): a TurnEngine shall own the harness turn lifecycle; TurnEngine.runTurn() is unit-testable without HTTP and yields browser-facing UIEvents while delegating SDK execution to query() after R1.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-071 (P0): /api/harness/turn shall become an SSE transport adapter handling request validation, session locking, attachment option forwarding, SSE encoding, cancellation cleanup, and error response handling.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-072 (P0): persisted runtime events shall use a stable versioned schema where each event includes schemaVersion, eventId, sessionId, optional turnId, timestamp, type, and data payload.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-073 (P0): session event storage shall be append-only JSONL; the writer appends newline-delimited events and replay ignores malformed trailing writes while preserving valid prior events.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-074 (P0): browser UIEvents and persisted HarnessEvents shall be separate contracts - the UI contract stays small while the runtime log can include richer SDK, permission, hook, tool, transcript, and artifact metadata.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-075 (P0): runtime logging shall redact secrets - API keys and configured secret variants are redacted from SDK errors, tool outputs where policy requires, and event records.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-076 (P1): runtime event replay shall reconstruct a transcript view producing accepted user messages, assistant deltas/completions, tool summaries, terminal outcomes, and artifact links.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-077 (P1): legacy session metadata layout shall remain readable during migration so existing .chirality/sessions/*.json records list/resume while the canonical folder layout is introduced.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-116 (P0): SDK messages shall be mapped deterministically into UI and runtime events - SDKSystemMessage, SDKAssistantMessage, SDKPartialAssistantMessage, SDKResultMessage, permission-denial, hook, compact-boundary, tool-progress, and subagent messages map to documented HarnessEvent categories.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-117 (P0): SDK settings isolation shall be explicit - shipped SDK options use settingSources: [], ['project'] is allowed only behind explicit development configuration, and user/local are never used in shipped builds.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-118 (P0): SDK session IDs shall be captured and linked - sdkSessionId is persisted from the first system/result message and future turns resume with explicit resume: sdkSessionId.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Initial persisted event categories include session.created, session.resumed, turn.accepted, turn.started, adapter.initialized, model.request.started, model.delta, model.completed, turn.completed, turn.failed, and turn.cancelled.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Later persisted event categories include tool.queued, tool.permission, tool.started, tool.progress, tool.completed, tool.failed, hook.started, hook.completed, context.compacted, subagent.started, subagent.completed, and runtime.mirror.error.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-078 (P0): opts.tools shall map to registered SDK built-ins or Chirality MCP tools or structured validation errors; built-in names map to SDK names like Read, Glob, Grep, LS, Write, Edit, and Bash, while Chirality tools use mcp__chirality__* names and unknown tool names are not silently passed through.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-079 (P0): Chirality-owned tools shall declare schema, permissions, read-only behavior, concurrency behavior, interruption behavior, execution, and summarization behavior; in-process MCP tool definitions and wrapper metadata are unit-tested and deterministic.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-080 (P0): tool-surface construction shall be deterministic - ordering, naming, MCP server IDs, and allow/deny lists are stable for a given session, persona, mode, and option set.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-081 (P0): denied tools shall not execute and should not be exposed when possible; bare disallowedTools remove tools from SDK context, scoped deny rules/hooks/dontAsk prevent execution, and allowedTools alone is never a restriction mechanism.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-082 (P0): read-only capability shall be enabled before write/edit/shell capability; initial user-visible tools are SDK read tools plus Chirality read MCP tools, with write/edit and bash denied until later phases.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-083 (P0): the model/tool loop shall be supplied by the SDK and mirrored by Chirality events, converting SDK tool-use, tool-result, permission-denial, hook, result, and compact-boundary messages into HarnessEvents and compact UI events.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-084 (P0): max-turn guards shall stop runaway loops; SDK maxTurns is set from resolved Chirality options and terminal max-turn errors are persisted.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-085 (P1): tool results shall appear in SSE and persisted runtime events; the UI sees compact progress/results while JSONL stores rich result metadata and artifact paths.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-086 (P1): concurrency behavior may rely on the SDK only after event ordering is testable, keeping Chirality replay deterministic even if the SDK executes safe tool activity concurrently.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-119 (P0): Chirality-specific deterministic operations shall be exposed as in-process SDK MCP tools - status read/transition, dependency CSV read/write, scope scan, and scaffold use createSdkMcpServer()/tool() or equivalent and pass through Chirality hooks and redaction.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Initial first-adapter tool sequence: (1) SDK read tools and Chirality read MCP tools, (2) Chirality status/dependency/scope/scaffold MCP tools, (3) SDK Write/Edit plus Chirality write MCP tools after write hooks and permission policy land, (4) SDK Bash only after timeout/result-storage/hook/interrupt/audit validation, (5) remote MCP, tool search, and plugins only after local tool governance matures.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-087 (P0): permission decisions shall be structured, recorded as allow, deny, or application-level ask with reason, source, provider/SDK tool use ID where present, and safe metadata.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-088 (P0): Chirality modes shall map to adapter permission modes plus overlay policy - readOnly, workspaceWrite, dontAsk, ask, and developer-only bypass are enforced by adapter permissionMode, allowedTools, disallowedTools, hooks, and canUseTool, not prompt text.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-089 (P0): explicit hard-deny rules shall override all allow decisions, including provider/SDK disallowedTools, hook denials, path/governance denials, protected-path rules, professional/release boundaries, and unvalidated provider/network expansion, overriding persona/session/operator allows and even developer-only bypass.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-090 (P0): dontAsk shall deny unapproved write, shell, network, or non-allowlisted actions; the denied action does not execute and emits permission/runtime events.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-091 (P0): readOnly shall expose or allow read-only tools only; write/edit/bash/network-capable tools are unavailable or hard-denied and plan/read-only mode behavior is validated.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-092 (P0): permission decisions shall be persisted; tool.permission events record behavior, source, reason, SDK tool name, and safe metadata.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-093 (P1): hooks shall run before and after SDK tool use - PreToolUse, PostToolUse, PostToolUseFailure, PreCompact, Stop, SubagentStart, and SubagentStop callbacks are recorded with duration and outcome where available.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-094 (P1): hook denials shall fail closed for write, shell, domain, and subagent tools; a denied or failed pre-tool hook prevents execution.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-095 (P1): first hooks shall enforce filesystem and provenance policy - validating project-root containment, blocking instruction-root writes, rejecting symlink writes, appending provenance/run evidence, and recording failure triage.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-120 (P0): interactive approval shall be mediated through canUseTool and application UI; the SDK callback may pause for user approval while Chirality persists the requested decision and returns SDK allow/deny only after the user or policy decides.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Permission mapping: Chirality readOnly maps to SDK plan or dontAsk with read tools pre-approved, overlaid by denying write/edit/bash/network-capable and unexpected tools.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Permission mapping: Chirality workspaceWrite maps to SDK acceptEdits only after write hooks pass (otherwise default with explicit approvals), overlaid by project-root containment, instruction-root block, symlink rejection, and provenance.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Permission mapping: Chirality dontAsk maps to SDK dontAsk, overlaid by pre-approving only exact safe tools while everything else denies without prompting.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Permission mapping: Chirality ask maps to SDK default with canUseTool, overlaid by presenting UI approval for governed writes/shell and persisting the decision before returning allow/deny.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: Permission mapping: Chirality bypass maps to SDK bypassPermissions only in developer-local mode, still applying disallowedTools, path hooks, instruction-root protection, and subagent governance and never shipped as ordinary mode.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-096 (P0): tool outputs shall be budgeted - small outputs inline, medium/large outputs preview, and raw large outputs stored under session artifacts with metadata.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-097 (P0): write/edit tools shall use safe filesystem behavior - paths resolve inside project root, symlinks are rejected initially, instruction-root writes are blocked, and edits require exact old content unless configured otherwise.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-098 (P1): context window management shall preserve auditability - the full Chirality event log stays on disk, SDK transcript linkage is preserved, and compaction boundaries are mirrored when the SDK emits them.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-099 (P1): compaction events shall be persisted - context.compacted records boundary, preserved recent turns where knowable, SDK compact metadata, and replay implications.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-100 (P1): bash shall remain unavailable unless explicitly governed and validated - denied bash never spawns, allowed bash captures stdout/stderr separately, times out, stores large output, and can be interrupted, without suppressing unrelated safe read/tool capability.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-101 (P1): subagent execution shall create governed child run records including parent session/turn, persona, agent name, SDK agent ID where available, model, project root, status, timestamps, and output artifact path.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-102 (P1): subagent tools and working directory shall be restricted - SDK agents definitions inherit or reduce parent permissions and cannot bypass evaluateSubagentGovernance.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-103 (P2): deferred tool search shall return only currently allowed tools, added only when catalog size justifies it and never revealing denied tools.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-104 (P1): in-process Chirality MCP tools shall pass through the same permission and hook overlay as SDK built-ins, preserving server metadata, preventing name collisions, and filtering or denying tools before execution.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-105 (P2): plugin-like extension points and remote MCP shall remain out of scope until mature guardrails exist; the product does not ship a marketplace/plugin system or remote tool expansion before local SDK governance is stable.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-121 (P0): SDK transcript handling shall not displace the Chirality audit mirror - SDK transcripts may be richer and resume-critical, but .chirality/sessions/<id>/events.jsonl remains the product-owned audit record.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-002: product doc SRC-DOCS-PRD -> CAT-012.

UnitStatement: FR-125 (P0): product-critical denies shall be enforced in Chirality-owned code or verified adapter callbacks/hooks - protected path writes, instruction-root writes, ambient settings, unapproved bash, ungated subagent delegation, unvalidated provider/network expansion, and human-gate transitions are denied even if provider/SDK defaults would allow them.

UnitStatement: FR-126 (P1): the runtime shall preserve an exit path from an adapter if a critical boundary cannot be governed; R0/R1 records fallback criteria and the minimal custom-runtime components required if the first-adapter probe fails.
